parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A man of weight 750 N stands a distance of 3.6 m from end D of a horizontal uniform beam
AD, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
The beam has a weight of 380 N and a length of 9.0 m. The beam is supported by a vertical
force F_{B} at pivot B and a vertical force F_{C} at pivot C. Pivot B is a distance of 2.0 m from end A
and pivot C is a distance of 2.0 m from end D. The beam is in equilibrium.
parts.question_text_latex:
A man of weight 750 N stands a distance of 3.6 m from end D of a horizontal uniform beam
AD, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
The beam has a weight of 380 N and a length of 9.0 m. The beam is supported by a vertical
force $F_{\mathrm{B}}$ at pivot B and a vertical force $F_{\mathrm{C}}$ at pivot C. Pivot B is a distance of 2.0 m from end A
and pivot C is a distance of 2.0 m from end D. The beam is in equilibrium.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
By using moments about pivot C, calculate F_{B}.
F_{B} = N
parts.question_text_latex:
By using moments about pivot C, calculate $F_{\mathrm{B}}$.
$F_{\mathrm{B}}$ = N

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
The man walks towards end D. The beam is about to tip when F_{B} becomes zero.
Determine the minimum distance x from end D that the man can stand without tipping
the beam.
x = m
parts.question_text_latex:
The man walks towards end D. The beam is about to tip when $F_{\mathrm{B}}$ becomes zero.
Determine the minimum distance x from end D that the man can stand without tipping
the beam.
$x = m $
